purpose: Canonical R1-only Dutch SWOW strength table (cue,response,R1.Strength), identical in structure to the EN/ES/ZH strength files used to build the *_edges_FINAL.csv graphs.

source.citation: De Deyne, Navarro, Storms (2013); De Deyne et al. (2019) Behavior Research Methods 51:987-1006

derivation.response_set: R1 only (asso1 = first response). asso2/asso3 are NOT used.
derivation.formula: R1.Strength(cue -> response) = count(asso1 == response among that cue's participants) / N_responses(cue)
derivation.denominator: N_responses(cue) = total asso1 rows for the cue = 100 for EVERY cue (SWOW-NL13 R100 design; verified min=median=max=100 across all 12571 cues).
derivation.missing_marker: The token 'x' (no-response marker) is RETAINED as a response and counted in the denominator, exactly as in the published strength file (4622 'x'-response rows present in the file).
derivation.no_thresholding: This file is the FULL strength table; NO count>=K threshold and NO reconstruction was applied. Thresholding (R1.Strength>=0.06, top-500) happens only downstream in complete_all_4_languages_FINAL.py to build dutch_edges_FINAL.csv.

verification.method: Independently recomputed R1.Strength from data/raw/SWOW-NL13/associationData.csv (asso1) and compared row-by-row to the strength file.
verification.result: 484587 / 485481 = 99.816% of strength rows reproduce to |diff| < 1e-6 (exact, since denominator = 100 => fractions are exact 2-decimals).
verification.normalization_invariant: Sum of R1.Strength over each cue's responses = 1.0000 exactly for all 12571 cues (1.0 == probability mass).

residual_explained.cause: 21 cues present in the strength file are ABSENT from the on-disk April-2012 associationData snapshot (e.g. amerikaans, india, frans, spaans, engeland, ...). The strength file derives from a marginally more complete SWOW-NL export than the .mat snapshot on disk. These 21 cues account for all 891 unmatched rows.
residual_explained.rounding_detail: 3 matched rows differ by exactly 0.01 (one participant out of 100), e.g. zelfzuchtig->egoistisch file 0.27 vs recompute 0.26 — off-by-one export differences, not normalization errors.

verification.conclusion: strength.SWOW-NL.R1.csv is a GENUINE R1-derived SWOW strength table (asso1, normalized by 100 participants/cue), NOT a threshold reconstruction and NOT fabricated. The same construction underlies the EN/ES/ZH strength files.

git_note: strength.SWOW-NL.R1.csv and the raw SWOW exports are gitignored by repo policy (data/raw/*.csv); their md5s are recorded here. The committed downstream artifact is data/processed/dutch_edges_FINAL.csv.
